subject: Pen test: evidence handoff, scope amendment, and cutover plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cyphersec.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test logistics — final inventory + delivery window

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the kickoff last week. We're lining up the engagement team and want to confirm two items so we can schedule the final testing window and plan the evidence handoff:

1) Final asset inventory (hosts, IP ranges, container registries, service accounts) — can you drop the canonical list to us by EOD Friday 24 Sep?

2) Preferred delivery method for draft/final reports and evidence: we can (a) upload encrypted drafts to our ShareFile link and grant view-only to your security team, or (b) deliver via SFTP to a customer-owned bucket. Which do you prefer?

Notes: we expect to run a 5 business day active test (whitebox + authenticated) and will provide a preliminary findings memo within 48 hours of the test completion. Final report + raw evidence package normally follows within 10 business days unless there's a major remediation cutover.

I've attached our access requirements checklist (cyphersec-access-reqs.pdf) — it lists the ephemeral account model we prefer and the minimum log retention/packet capture windows we need.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through access.

—Elena
Director, Engagements
CypherSec Labs

Attachments: cyphersec-access-reqs.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cyphersec.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test logistics — final inventory + delivery window

Elena —

Thanks for the note. We're on track to deliver the canonical inventory by EOD today (see comment below). Regarding delivery method we'd prefer the encrypted ShareFile upload to start (option a) and then move artifacts to our secure S3 bucket once we validate checksums. Please also redact any PII in the public executive summary — we'll need a redacted summary for our compliance folder.

Proposed test window: Mon 5 Oct — Fri 9 Oct (5 business days). Please confirm that aligns with your team availability.

Laura, Neha — looping you in to coordinate temporary credentials, VPN/ bastion access, and Audit log retention. Laura: can you confirm whether we can provision an ephemeral service account with scoped S3 read for evidence retrieval and grant cyphersec VPN access to the staging VPC?

Marcus
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: none

From: Elena Morales <elena@cyphersec.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: RedTeam Ops <ops@redteamlabs.io>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test logistics — scope clarification and additional asset

Marcus —

Confirmed for 5–9 Oct. Two quick clarifications based on the inventory you shared:

- Scope amendment request: we'd like to include the container registry (registry.acmehealth.internal) and the image-pushing CI runner (ci-runner-01) in the authenticated portion. That adds ~8 auth test targets. Please confirm if that is acceptable from an operational/risk perspective.

- Access model: we'll take the ephemeral service account + MFA-based jump host you proposed. For evidence, we'll upload the draft report and the raw pcaps/log bundles to our ShareFile link (rl-7241-draft) and simultaneously provide md5 checksums. Please provide the S3 bucket name and an S3 read-only principal if you want us to push a copy there after initial upload.

If scope amendment is approved we'll shift the start by 24 hours to Mon 6 Oct to allow your engineering team a day for final config.

Best —
Elena

On Fri, Sep 24, 2026 at 09:05, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Laura, Neha — looping you in to coordinate temporary credentials...

Attachments: cyphersec-access-reqs.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cyphersec.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ops Team <ops@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test logistics — creds, VPN, and inventory

Hi Elena / Marcus —

We're good to proceed with the container registry and CI runner being in scope. Confirmed changes below:

- Start date: Mon 6 Oct (shifted +24h)
- Ephemeral access: created role "cyphersec-ephemeral" (valid 6 Oct 08:00 — 13 Oct 23:59 PT). We'll send SAML assertion + short-lived STS creds to the vendor email.
- VPN: temporary VPN jump host (vpn-jump-03.acmehealth.internal) created; creds will be delivered via the company Secure Vault (one-time fetch link).
- Evidence retention: audit logs for the staging VPC will be retained for 30 days; packet capture retention is set to 14 days.

I've attached the inventory export (PT_inventory_20261007.csv) and an operations runbook with the exact permission snippets. Please acknowledge you received the files.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Infrastructure Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

> On Fri, Oct 1, 2026 at 14:05, Elena Morales <elena@cyphersec.com> wrote:
> > If scope amendment is approved we'll shift the start by 24 hours to Mon 6 Oct...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cyphersec.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final deliverables & evidence handoff plan — acceptance and cutover

Elena / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround on provisioning and for shifting the start window. This note confirms the deliverable expectations and cutover/acceptance criteria:

1) Draft report: upload encrypted draft to the ShareFile RL link within 48 hours of test completion (expected upload by Wed 14 Oct). Include a concise executive summary (one page) with risk ratings and mitigations.
2) Raw evidence bundle: Provide MD5 checksums and an upload to ShareFile + optional push to our S3 (bucket: s3://acmehealth-redwood-pt/rl-7241) using the read-only principal created for cyphersec.
3) Redaction: redact customer PII in the public executive summary. Non-public technical details can remain unredacted in the secure bundle.
4) Remediation tracking: please create a ticket per distinct vulnerability in our SEC-4321 epic and mark high/medium/low tags. We'll expect status updates in the remediation tracker within 7 business days of the draft.
5) Final report ETA: no later than Tue 26 Oct (10 business days after test completion). If delivery slips, notify Marcus + Laura immediately with reason and new ETA.

We attached a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_20261015.xlsx) that lays out owners and SLAs for verification. Laura: once we have the draft I'll kick off a short remediation validation window and we can arrange a synchronized cutover for any critical fixes.

One ask: for external-facing summary use the redacted executive summary only — we will not distribute technical findings outside the security review channel.

Appreciate the partnership. Elena — please reply to confirm you have signature access to the ShareFile link and that your team will create the SEC-4321 tickets as noted.

Marcus
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
